caption: The video captures a calm lake mirroring a snow-dusted mountain ridge and a golden-brown hillside under a clear blue sky. A grassy slope descends on the left toward the water, while a small cluster of trees and a pale structure sit on the right shoreline. Dry reeds poke up in the lower-left foreground and bare branches intrude from the right edge, all of which hold their positions. The real landscape remains fixed, but the lake surface is not perfectly still. Gentle, continuous ripples deform the mirror image, so the reflected ridge and hillside waver and stretch horizontally. At moments the reflection reads as crisp, then it breaks into streaked bands of light and shadow as the small waves pass. This slow, ongoing distortion of the water's reflection is the only visible motion, with no object entering, exiting, or shifting across the scene.
relations: Small surface ripples continuously deform the reflected mountain ridge and hillside across the lake.
The real landscape remains fixed while its mirror image wavers and stretches horizontally as waves pass.
Passing ripples break the crisp reflection into streaked bands of light and shadow on the water.
